mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_item_options (order_item_id, product_option_id, option_group_name, option_name, additional_price) VALUES (#{orderItemId}, #{productOptionId}, #{optionGroupName}, #{optionName}, #{additionalPrice})
INSERT INTO order_item_images (order_item_id, image_url, sort_order) VALUES (#{orderItemId}, #{imageUrl}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_item_id, product_option_id, option_group_name, option_name, additional_price FROM order_item_options WHERE order_item_id = #{orderItemId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, order_item_id, image_url, sort_order FROM order_item_images WHERE order_item_id = #{orderItemId} ORDER BY sort_order, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO custom_order_quotes (order_id, version, quoted_amount, producible_date, admin_note, issued_by, status, sent_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{version}, #{quotedAmount}, #{producibleDate}, #{adminNote}, #{issuedBy}, #{status}, #{sentAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM custom_order_quotes WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY version DESC
SELECT FROM custom_order_quotes WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM custom_order_quotes WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE custom_order_quotes SET status = 'SUPERSEDED' WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'SENT'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO custom_order_payment_links (quote_id, token, amount, expires_at, status) VALUES (#{quoteId}, #{token}, #{amount}, #{expiresAt}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM custom_order_payment_links WHERE token = #{token} FOR UPDATE
